technique_name: Explain why trade protectionism can hurt the economy of a country.
description: Trade protectionism is the practice of protecting domestic industries from foreign competition by imposing tariffs or other restrictions. This practice can be detrimental to the economy of the country that implements it because it raises the cost of imported goods, making them less affordable to consumers.
